## Introduction

Building web products that feel intentional.

Mahdi is a developer focused on the Vue and Nuxt ecosystem. He builds fast, feature-rich applications with an emphasis on clean architecture, SSR, maintainability and production quality.

### Core stack

- Vue (https://vuejs.org/): UI framework
- Nuxt (https://nuxt.com/): Application framework
- Vuetify (https://vuetifyjs.com/): Component systems
- TypeScript (https://typescriptlang.org/): Type-safe development
- Pinia (https://pinia.vuejs.org/): State management
- i18n (https://i18n.nuxtjs.org/): Internationalization

## About

From complex requirements to clean interfaces.

Product-minded development across dashboards, admin tools, data-heavy views and feature-rich web applications.

Mahdi enjoys turning complex requirements into clean, maintainable interfaces. His day-to-day work covers feature-rich applications, dashboards, admin tools, data-heavy views and everything in between.

He cares about performance, accessibility and developer experience, from structuring stores and composables sensibly to shipping reliable production builds.

### Key facts

- Vue, Nuxt & Vuetify: Primary focus, including SSR
- Architecture: Clean, scalable and maintainable
- Production-minded: Tooling, builds and polish
